{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, stripping commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders that are NOT refunded AND NOT QA
loyal_completed_valid = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue on valid data
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_valid['revenue'].mean()

# Print evidence
print(f'Number of valid LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed_valid)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of valid LOYAL completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
